Sandbox_RemoveLimits_CharacterMode_toolt: Controls the character's real native maximum carry weight, Heavy Load status, displayed limit, and character-inventory transfer limit. Unlimited uses a practical limit of 1000000.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_CharacterCapacityLi: The real character carry limit and character-inventory transfer limit when Carry Weight is set to Custom limit.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_ContainerMode_toolt: Keep vanilla transfer limits, multiply each container's original weight limit, or allow transfers without a weight limit.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_ContainerMultiplier: Applied when Transfer Weight is set to Multiplier. The original weight limit and Organized/Disorganized effects are preserved.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AffectBags_tooltip: Apply the transfer weight mode to carried and stored bags.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AffectWorldContaine: Apply the transfer weight mode to cupboards, crates, furniture, corpses, and other world containers. Floor item safety remains vanilla.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AffectVehicles_tool: Apply the transfer weight mode to trunks, glove boxes, seats, and bags stored in vehicles.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AllowSeatWithItems: 2. Transfer Weight — Allow seats to contain items
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AllowSeatWithItems_: When vehicle containers are expanded, items on a seat do not prevent a character from sitting there. A seated character still occupies the seat.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_IgnoreVehicleCargoM: 3. Vehicle Cargo Mass — Ignore stored cargo
When enabled, items stored in vehicle containers do not increase the vehicle's physics mass. Installed vehicle parts still count.
